setup.title: Connect GitHub
instructions: Create a GitHub App, install it on the repositories you want to allow, and download its RSA private key.
Use the numeric App ID from its settings (not the client ID) and the installation ID from its installation URL.
The App key stays on the owner host; commands in the yard receive temporary installation tokens.
setup.label: github-app
setup.followup: Repository access has not been tested. In the yard, run: subyard-github run -- gh repo view OWNER/REPO
